sections.title: The one thing to remember about this module
sections.body: A good test has three parts: setup (arrange), action (act), assertion (assert). One assertion per test — if you have three expects, you have three tests. The test database resets between tests so each test starts clean. Run the specific test file you are working on, not the whole suite.

sections.title: How to answer these questions in an interview
sections.body: At fresher level, interviewers want to see that you understand the concept clearly enough to explain it simply. You don't need internals. You need a clear definition, a small code example, and one reason why it matters. Aim for 60-90 seconds per answer. Define the term, show a snippet, name the trade-off or common mistake.
